text:
Sara: FYI after the kernel-selector rollout I'm seeing host-side p50 increase ~10% for streaming. writev syscall count spiked.
Raj: can you attach a flame?
Sara: flame uploaded https://internal.prod/flames/8101234567. writev calls ~3x baseline; lots of <200B writes.
Evan: confirmed in traces. gRPC is emitting many tiny frames; looks like fragmentation at preparse boundary.
Mike: kernel-selector routed some requests to fused-attn path; that codepath changes token chunk boundaries upstream.
Linda: KV cache miss rate up ~12% in the same window — might be related (more KV lookups due to fragmentation).
Raj: mitigation options: 1) sidecar coalesce tiny writes (4KB threshold), 2) tune socket buffers, 3) rollback selector flag.
Evan: microbench (stream qps=400): baseline p50=27.9ms p95=84ms; regressed p50=30.8ms p95=99ms; proxy-coalesce(4KB) p50=28.2ms p95=87ms.
Mike: I'll prototype a sidecar write-aggregator that batches frames until threshold or chunk end, plus metric small_write_rate.
Sara: repro curl for streaming: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"x","stream":true,"max_tokens":200}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream/generate — you can see many sub-100B frames.
Linda: adding perf-harness case with skewed token lengths to catch fragmentation (token_lengths=[1,1,1,6,1,1,12]).
Raj: long-term: kernel-selector must preserve ingress fragmentation or add re-chunk step. Mike/Ryan to own invariant.
Mike: opening PR for sidecar coalescer + unit tests, will canary on 5 hosts after review.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: canary-81 -> prod-us-west (5 hosts).
Evan: after canary small_write_rate dropped ~75% and p50 returned to ~28.5ms. p95 still slightly high; investigating KV miss correlation.
Sara: ACTIONS:
- Mike: implement coalesce (4KB default) + metrics — EOD
- Raj: rollback toggle plan if canary regresses
- Evan: add KV-eviction telemetry correlated with fragmentation
- Linda: update batch-heuristic tests in perf harness
:thumbsup:
Mike: starting branch now.
Sara: will monitor canary and post updates here.
